def simulate_fixed(N, n, initial_p):
    current_guests = list(range(N))
    current_tags = list(initial_p)
    
    for r in range(n):
        # 1. Identify who leaves
        leaving = [g for g in current_guests if current_tags[g] == g]
        
        # 2. Update current_guests
        remaining = [g for g in current_guests if g not in leaving]
        
        if not remaining:
            return False # Everyone left
        
        # 3. Pass tags to the right among remaining guests
        new_tags = {g: None for g in remaining}
        for i in range(len(remaining)):
            giver = remaining[i]
            receiver = remaining[(i + 1) % len(remaining)]
            new_tags[receiver] = current_tags[giver]
        
        # Update current_tags and current_guests
        current_guests = remaining
        for g in current_guests:
            current_tags[g] = new_tags[g]
            
    return len(current_guests) > 0

def count_staying(N, n):
    count = 0
    for p in itertools.permutations(range(N)):
        if simulate_fixed(N, n, p):
            count += 1
    return count
